functions.name: bsp_audio_init
functions.doc: Prepare I2S and ES8389 using the existing ALDO2 supply.

functions.name: bsp_audio_get_codec_itf
functions.doc: Borrow the I2S interface from the current ESP-BSP audio instance.

functions.name: bsp_audio_codec_speaker_init
functions.doc: Borrow the shared duplex codec. Open it once for simultaneous playback and recording. Stop users and call bsp_audio_deinit() to release it.

functions.name: bsp_i2c_init
functions.doc: Acquire the ESP-BSP bus reference. Repeated initialization is idempotent. The initial acquisition checks whether the board's charge profile can be applied. @note Use from task context. Lifecycle calls may return ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE during another board operation. Retry from the control task.

functions.name: bsp_i2c_deinit
functions.doc: Remove application devices before releasing the ESP-BSP bus reference.

functions.name: bsp_i2c_get_handle
functions.doc: Initialize the ESP-BSP bus as in bsp_i2c_init() and return its borrowed handle.

functions.name: candis_i2c_acquire
functions.doc: Acquire one reference and apply the initial board charge profile when eligible. Remove your I2C devices before release.

functions.name: candis_display_start_raw
functions.doc: Start panel-only mode. Touch and asynchronous LVGL refresh settings are ignored.

functions.name: candis_display_draw_rgb565
functions.doc: Present a packed, native-endian 480 x 480 RGB565 frame in panel-only mode. Call from a control task. The caller may reuse pixels when the call returns. ESP_OK means every panel DMA strip completed.

functions.name: candis_display_start
functions.doc: Call lifecycle and brightness APIs from a control task outside the LVGL lock.

functions.name: candis_display_get_touch_points
functions.doc: Call with the display lock held. Capacity is two contacts.

functions.name: candis_audio_open
functions.doc: Open duplex stereo PCM, 48 kHz and 16 bits, at 100% volume (-6 dB DAC), with the amplifier off.

functions.name: candis_audio_set_volume
functions.doc: Set playback level, 0–100, with a -6 dB codec ceiling. Zero disables the amplifier.

functions.name: candis_audio_set_mute
functions.doc: Mute the codec and turn off the amplifiers. Unmuting keeps the amplifiers off. Queue silence and call candis_audio_set_output(true) before resuming playback.

functions.name: candis_audio_set_output
functions.doc: Enable or disable the amplifier. Write silence before enabling or disabling.

functions.name: candis_audio_read
functions.parameters: int16_t *pcm, size_t frames, size_t *received, uint32_t timeout_ms
functions.doc: PCM calls report actual frames even if the supplied timeout expires. One RX task and one TX task may run together. Concurrent calls on the same direction and calls during teardown return ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: candis_audio_write
functions.parameters: const int16_t *pcm, size_t frames, size_t *sent, uint32_t timeout_ms

functions.name: candis_audio_playback_write
functions.parameters: const int16_t *pcm, size_t frames, size_t *sent, uint32_t timeout_ms
functions.doc: Write up to 240 frames with up to 4x digital gain and a 25000 peak limit. Fade the source at clip boundaries in the app. Use one TX writer per session.

functions.name: candis_audio_close
functions.doc: Quiesce readers and writers before closing. Returns ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE while an operation is in flight. Use from task context.

functions.name: candis_baseboard_decode
functions.doc: Validate the three CRCs and exact Candis identity tuple. Output is set only on success.

functions.name: candis_baseboard_probe_state_on_bus
functions.parameters: candis_baseboard_kind_t expected, i2c_master_bus_handle_t bus, uint8_t address, candis_capability_state_t *state, candis_baseboard_info_t *info
functions.doc: Classify a board descriptor without treating an absent or unusable endpoint as a fatal probe error. A valid descriptor for another board, or a descriptor with corrupt metadata, is reported as CANDIS_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED. A missing endpoint or an address/read NACK is reported as CANDIS_CAPABILITY_NOT_PRESENT. Other bus failures remain errors.

functions.name: candis_i2c_probe_addresses
functions.parameters: i2c_master_bus_handle_t bus, const uint8_t *addresses, size_t count, uint32_t *responding

functions.name: candis_imu_start_with_config
functions.doc: @brief Start using a caller-owned I2C bus and caller-selected address. The caller owns sensing power and must keep the bus alive until stop. @return ESP_ERR_INVALID_ARG for unsupported settings, ESP_ERR_NOT_FOUND if no BMI270 responds, or ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE if already acquired. Underlying bus errors propagate.

functions.name: candis_imu_probe
functions.doc: Probe the caller-selected bus/address without starting measurements.

functions.name: candis_imu_suspend
functions.doc: Stop the sensor blocks and enable advanced power save while retaining the caller's bus.

functions.name: candis_imu_resume
functions.doc: Exit advanced power save and resume with the same sampling settings.

functions.name: candis_imu_read
functions.doc: Read shadowed acceleration, angular velocity and sensor time in one I2C burst. timestamp_us is the host time at read completion. sensor_ticks is the device counter sampled with the burst. Output is set only on success. ESP_ERR_NOT_FINISHED means the first sample after start or resume is pending.

functions.name: candis_imu_read_temperature
functions.doc: Read the BMI270 die temperature in °C. ESP_ERR_NOT_FINISHED means the first conversion is pending.

functions.name: candis_imu_stop
functions.doc: Stop measurements and remove the BMI270 device from the caller's bus.

functions.name: candis_motor_init
functions.doc: Configure caller-selected PWM and optional PMU supply. No output may be active. amplitude_min_duty_percent sets the first nonzero drive level and amplitude_max_duty_percent sets amplitude 100. Both are 1-100.

functions.name: candis_motor_amplitude_to_duty
functions.doc: Map a calibrated amplitude (0-100) to a PWM duty. Returns 0 when unconfigured.

functions.name: candis_motor_duty_to_amplitude
functions.doc: Map a PWM duty back to the calibrated amplitude where possible.

functions.name: candis_motor_start_amplitude
functions.doc: Start a continuous output at 1-100 percent calibrated vibration amplitude.

functions.name: candis_motor_set_amplitude
functions.doc: Change the amplitude of an active output. Amplitude 0 stops the output.

functions.name: candis_motor_set_frequency
functions.doc: Change the PWM carrier frequency, including while output is active.

functions.name: candis_motor_start
functions.doc: Start a continuous raw-PWM output at 1-100 percent duty.

functions.name: candis_motor_set_duty
functions.doc: Change raw duty of an active output. Continuous effects use set_amplitude().

functions.name: candis_motor_pulse
functions.doc: Run a bounded PWM pulse (1–100%, 1–600 ms) on the configured output. The caller owns GPIO and supply selection. Timing uses the FreeRTOS scheduler.

functions.name: candis_motor_pulse_amplitude
functions.doc: Run a calibrated-amplitude pulse for 1-600 ms.

functions.name: candis_motor_stop
functions.doc: Cancel continuous or timed output and release resources. Call again if cleanup fails.

functions.name: candis_power_read
functions.doc: Snapshot board rails. This call does not write the PMU.

functions.name: candis_power_read_supply
functions.doc: Read TG28 supply and charge status, and the BLDO2 programmed setpoint.

functions.name: candis_power_read_battery_uv
functions.doc: Read VBAT in microvolts when a battery is present and the VBAT ADC is already enabled.

functions.name: candis_power_ensure_default_charge
functions.doc: @brief Apply the board's 200 mA charge-current default after validating the charger. The TG28-ESP OTP value for this board is 50 mA. This call changes only REG62[4:0] after three consecutive samples establish that VBUS and the battery are present, the charger is enabled, CV is 4.20 V, safety timers are enabled, and no charger or input-limit fault is active. It then reads the setting back. Call from a control task when VBUS and the battery become available following startup.

functions.name: candis_expansion_power_acquire
functions.doc: Acquire the legacy singleton application reference to DC1SW. Set manage_power only when the attached loads are known. If acquisition fails, call release to retry any pending rollback before trying again. With manage_power false, DC1SW must already be enabled.

functions.name: candis_expansion_power_release
functions.doc: Release the application reference after its peripherals are idle. Retry on failure.

functions.name: candis_expansion_power_claim
functions.doc: @brief Acquire a private DC1SW reference for an application or component. @param[in] manage_power Allow enabling DC1SW after checking all attached loads. With false, DC1SW must already be enabled or acquisition returns ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE. @param[out] handle Empty handle slot owned by this caller. Do not copy or reuse a live handle. @return ESP_OK on success. On error, a non-NULL handle requires unclaim to retry rollback.

functions.name: candis_expansion_power_unclaim
functions.doc: @brief Release the caller's reference after its clients have stopped using DC1SW. @return ESP_OK and a cleared handle on success, including an already cleared handle. On error the handle remains valid for a retry.

functions.name: candis_expansion_ldo_acquire
functions.parameters: candis_expansion_ldo_t rail, uint16_t voltage_mv, unsigned settle_ms, candis_expansion_ldo_handle_t *handle
functions.doc: Claim an expansion LDO exclusively. The attached expansion must support the requested voltage (500–3500 mV, in 100 mV steps). An already enabled rail is accepted only at the requested setting and stays enabled on release. Initialize the output slot to CANDIS_EXPANSION_LDO_HANDLE_NONE. A token returned on error represents a partial lease. Pass it to candis_expansion_ldo_release() to retry cleanup. An output slot containing an active token is preserved and rejected with ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE. The caller must clear the released output slot with CANDIS_EXPANSION_LDO_HANDLE_NONE before reusing it.

functions.name: candis_expansion_ldo_release
functions.doc: Restore the original rail state. Retry with the same token if cleanup fails. A release request for an expired token returns ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: candis_rtc_get_time
functions.doc: Read the RX8130CE calendar in UTC (2000–2099). tm_isdst is set to zero. Returns ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE if the RTC reports a loss of validity or STOP. Does not change RTC flags, backup selection or shared interrupt configuration.

functions.name: candis_rtc_set_time
functions.doc: Set the UTC calendar (2000–2099), deriving the weekday from the date. The RTC timer and interrupt enables must be idle. With recover_invalid=true, VLF authorizes reinitializing idle alarm, timer, offset and backup settings. An enabled backup charger prevents recovery. TG28 and its IRQ are untouched.

functions.name: candis_rtc_arm_update_irq
functions.doc: Configure the idle RX8130CE to pulse the shared GPIO0 line at each second update. Requires a valid calendar and exclusive use of the RTC interrupt configuration. The app configures GPIO0 and any ESP sleep wake sources. TG28 is untouched. If restore_pending remains set on error, retry candis_rtc_disarm_update_irq().

functions.name: candis_rtc_disarm_update_irq
functions.doc: Read the RTC update flag, disable its interrupt, and restore the update interval. Call on wake or if sleep is canceled. updated may be NULL. An RTC update flag alone does not identify the source of a shared GPIO0 interrupt.

functions.name: candis_storage_configure
functions.doc: Configure the storage transport. No operation may be active. The slot is copied and may use any available GPIO assignment. Set slot.cd to SDMMC_SLOT_NO_CD when card detection is not wired. Set use_dc1sw only when the selected baseboard derives card power from that core PMU rail.

functions.name: candis_storage_reset_config
functions.doc: Forget the runtime configuration after all storage and detect operations stop.

functions.name: bsp_sdcard_mount
functions.doc: Mount the configured SDMMC slot at BSP_SD_MOUNT_POINT. Never formats.

functions.name: bsp_sdcard_unmount
functions.doc: Close all files first. Releases the mount started by bsp_sdcard_mount().

functions.name: bsp_sdcard_get_handle
functions.doc: Borrow the current BSP card handle. Valid until the matching unmount.

functions.name: bsp_sdcard_get_sdmmc_host
functions.doc: Fill a generic SDMMC host configuration. Pins are supplied by the slot.

functions.name: bsp_sdcard_sdmmc_get_slot
functions.doc: Copy the slot supplied to candis_storage_configure().

functions.name: bsp_sdcard_get_sdspi_host
functions.doc: Fill a generic SDSPI host configuration.

functions.name: bsp_sdcard_sdspi_get_slot
functions.doc: Fill an SDSPI slot placeholder for the caller to complete.

functions.name: bsp_sdcard_sdmmc_mount
functions.doc: Mount caller-supplied SDMMC hardware. Never formats.

functions.name: bsp_sdcard_sdspi_mount
functions.doc: SDSPI mounting is not implemented by this component.

functions.name: candis_storage_mount
functions.doc: Mount a configured FAT volume in one- or four-bit mode. The card is never formatted. manage_power may enable DC1SW only when the configured transport opted into it. Keep the returned card valid by closing all files before unmounting.

functions.name: candis_storage_mount_with_config
functions.doc: Mount with an explicit FAT VFS write policy.

functions.name: candis_storage_unmount
functions.doc: Release the mount, pins and power lease. Call again if power release fails.

functions.name: candis_storage_check_card
functions.doc: Check physical presence during an active mount.

functions.name: candis_storage_detect_start
functions.doc: Claim the configured card detect input and optional DC1SW reference. Requires candis_storage_configure().

functions.name: candis_storage_detect_read
functions.doc: Read the raw switch level as card presence. Debounce it in the caller.

functions.name: candis_storage_detect_stop
functions.doc: Release the switch input and optional DC1SW reference.

functions.name: candis_usb_device_start
functions.doc: Start native CDC. The application's stdio routing is independent. Repeated calls are idempotent while the device role remains active. @return ESP_OK if started, ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE if the OTG PHY is busy or a previous teardown is pending, ESP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED if disabled. @note Use one OTG stack per port. Stop any separate example CDC console first.

functions.name: candis_usb_device_stop
functions.doc: Detach CDC and release the OTG PHY. Retry if teardown reports an error.

functions.name: candis_usb_device_read
functions.doc: Nonblocking CDC I/O, reporting bytes read or queued.

functions.name: bsp_usb_host_start
functions.doc: Start the native Host stack with the board's autonomous Type-C supply. Pass BSP_USB_HOST_POWER_MODE_AUTO and false. The USB-C source and current limit are set by hardware. Validate the attached source setup first.

functions.name: bsp_usb_host_stop
functions.doc: Release host clients before stopping. Stop releases the stack and PHY. Host and Device require matching stop calls before switching roles. A failed stop may be retried before attempting the new role.

functions.name: bsp_display_new
functions.doc: @brief Create the native RGB565 panel on an already powered rail. @note Call esp_lcd_panel_disp_on_off() and set brightness explicitly. Draw coordinates use exclusive ends. All four edges must be even. The BSP owns the IO and SPI bus. Release via esp_lcd_panel_del() or bsp_display_delete(), which both release the panel and its resources.

functions.name: bsp_display_new_with_handles
functions.doc: Create the native panel and return all handles owned by the BSP.

functions.name: bsp_display_delete
functions.doc: Release a panel created by bsp_display_new().

functions.name: bsp_display_start
functions.doc: Start LVGL with the default Candis configuration. Turn brightness on explicitly.

functions.name: bsp_display_start_with_config
functions.doc: Start the LVGL display with an explicit LVGL configuration.

functions.name: bsp_display_stop
functions.doc: Stop the display when the supplied handle belongs to the active instance.

functions.name: bsp_display_get_input_dev
functions.doc: Return the LVGL input device for the active display.

functions.name: bsp_display_rotate
functions.doc: Rotate the active LVGL display in software.

functions.name: bsp_display_lock
functions.doc: Take the LVGL lock. A timeout of zero waits indefinitely.

functions.name: bsp_display_unlock
functions.doc: Release the LVGL lock.

functions.name: bsp_display_enter_sleep
functions.doc: Put the panel and CST9220 into sleep without releasing their resources. Repeated calls while already asleep are no-ops returning ESP_OK.

functions.name: bsp_display_exit_sleep
functions.doc: Wake the panel and CST9220 after bsp_display_enter_sleep(). Repeated calls while already awake are no-ops returning ESP_OK.

functions.name: bsp_display_brightness_init
functions.doc: @brief Initialize display brightness control. Candis uses panel register brightness and does not allocate a separate PWM channel. The call is kept for ESP-BSP compatibility.

functions.name: bsp_touch_new
functions.doc: Open CST9220 independently of LVGL using the existing display supply.

functions.name: bsp_touch_del
functions.doc: Release the touch handle, its IO and its display rail. On failure, call bsp_touch_del(NULL) to finish pending cleanup.

functions.name: candis_touch_new_with_config
functions.doc: Create CST9220 with explicit Candis axis and mirror mapping.

functions.name: candis_touch_read
functions.doc: @brief Read up to two contacts from the standalone CST9220. @param[in] touch Handle returned by bsp_touch_new() or candis_touch_new_with_config(). @param[out] points Storage for two contacts with the configured axis mapping. @param[out] count Number of contacts on success. @return ESP_OK on a new report, ESP_ERR_NOT_FINISHED if no report is ready, or an error from the driver. Output is set only on success.

functions.name: candis_camera_init
functions.doc: Start one configured DVP instance. Call lifecycle APIs from one control task. Reserve the configured pins, XCLK LEDC resources and ESP Video DVP instance for this component. Serialize ESP Video lifecycle calls in the application. On a cleanup failure, call stop again before retrying start.

functions.name: candis_camera_get_active_profile
functions.doc: Identify the active sensor after the DVP device has detected it.

functions.name: candis_camera_control_query
functions.doc: Query a control after initialization, between borrowed frames.

functions.name: candis_camera_control_get
functions.doc: Read or write a control during capture, between borrowed frames. Write-only sensor controls return ESP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED when read.

functions.name: candis_camera_device
functions.doc: Native V4L2 path. Use either native capture or the stream API for a session.

functions.name: candis_camera_get_mode
functions.doc: Enumerate compiled sensor modes starting at index zero, with capture stopped.

functions.name: candis_camera_get_pixel_format
functions.doc: Enumerate DVP output formats for the active sensor mode, with capture stopped. Indexes start at zero. ESP_ERR_NOT_FOUND signals the end of the list.

functions.name: candis_camera_stream_start
functions.doc: Configure and start capture with two reusable DMA buffers. NULL config uses defaults. The optional format output describes the actual dimensions, stride and pixel format. Call all capture APIs from the same control task.

functions.name: candis_camera_read_sensor_id
functions.doc: Read the sensor identification after initialization, between borrowed frames.

functions.name: candis_camera_set_flip
functions.doc: Set one sensor orientation control between frames.

functions.name: candis_camera_set_test_pattern
functions.doc: Toggle the sensor's diagnostic pattern between frames.

functions.name: candis_camera_frame_acquire
functions.doc: Borrow one frame until frame_release() or stream_stop(). Only one frame may be borrowed.

functions.name: candis_camera_capture_frame
functions.doc: Copy one frame into caller-owned storage. The stream stays active.

functions.name: candis_camera_stream_stop
functions.doc: Stop capture, invalidate any borrowed frame and release the stream resources.

functions.name: candis_camera_stop
functions.doc: Release camera hardware and any stream opened through this API. Close native V4L2 file descriptors before calling. Safe to call again after success.

functions.name: candis_camera_profile_matches_id
functions.doc: Check a detected sensor ID against a selected profile.

functions.name: candis_dock_probe
functions.doc: Read and validate the Dock descriptor while DC1SW is already powered. The caller must release UART0 on GPIO58/59 and any external driver on those pins. A valid descriptor for another board returns ESP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED. On error, the caller's identity is untouched.

functions.name: candis_dock_get_state
functions.doc: Classify the Dock as absent, present, or initialized. The probe path requires the expansion rail and UART0 handover described for candis_dock_probe().

functions.name: candis_dock_open
functions.doc: Hold a private DC1SW lease and identify the Dock. Set manage_power only after checking the total attached load (TF, IMU, EEPROM and modules). The GPIO58/59 requirements of candis_dock_probe() apply. Other DC1SW clients retain their leases when the Dock session closes. A second open returns ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE while the first session exists.

functions.name: candis_dock_close
functions.doc: Call after unmounting the card and stopping detection. Repeated close is safe. Retry close if release failed, including when open logged a rollback failure.

functions.name: candis_dock_read_eeprom
functions.doc: Read raw Dock descriptor bytes from EEPROM address 0x50 while the session is initialized. The component serializes access on its owned expansion bus. The destination is valid only on ESP_OK.

functions.name: candis_dock_get_speaker_channel
functions.doc: Resolve CN3 from a verified Dock descriptor. Output is set only on success.

functions.name: candis_dock_mount
functions.doc: Mount the Dock card using GPIO39 and an existing, powered DC1SW domain.

functions.name: candis_dock_mount_with_power
functions.parameters: const candis_baseboard_info_t *identity, const char *path, bool manage_power, sdmmc_card_t **card
functions.doc: Mount from a verified Dock descriptor. Opt in to DC1SW control only with the entire expansion load confirmed. Release with candis_storage_unmount().

functions.name: candis_dock_mount_with_config
functions.parameters: const candis_baseboard_info_t *identity, const char *path, const candis_storage_mount_config_t *config, sdmmc_card_t **card
functions.doc: Mount a Dock card with an explicit VFS and power policy.

functions.name: candis_dock_detect_start
functions.doc: Claim the Dock GPIO39 detect input while the existing DC1SW domain is powered. The module at U6 must leave its shared GPIO39 connection high impedance. Read and release with candis_storage_detect_read() and candis_storage_detect_stop().

functions.name: candis_dock_probe_modules
functions.doc: Check ACKs at the two expected EEPROM addresses on a verified Dock. The caller verifies the attached modules and releases UART0 before probing. Output describes address responses. It is set only on success.

types.name: candis_dock_speaker_channel_t
types.declaration: typedef enum { CANDIS_DOCK_SPEAKER_LEFT = 0, CANDIS_DOCK_SPEAKER_RIGHT = 1, }
types.doc: Interleaved PCM slot connected to the Dock's CN3 speaker connector.

functions.name: tg28_esp_open
functions.doc: Attach a zero-initialized context to a caller-owned bus without accessing registers. Keep the bus alive until close succeeds. Serialize calls to the same PMU across all contexts, including any direct register access.

functions.name: tg28_esp_close
functions.doc: Detach the device. On failure the caller may retry with the same context.

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_outputs
functions.doc: Read REG90. Each enabled output is represented by a tg28_esp_output_t bit.

functions.name: tg28_esp_set_outputs
functions.parameters: const tg28_esp_t *pmu, uint8_t mask, bool enabled
functions.doc: Update only the selected REG90 bits and skip the write when already equal.

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_ldo_code
functions.doc: Read the five-bit voltage field, including any reserved code read back.

functions.name: tg28_esp_set_ldo_code
functions.parameters: const tg28_esp_t *pmu, tg28_esp_ldo_t ldo, uint8_t code
functions.doc: Set the five-bit voltage field. Use codes 0 through 30 for new voltage settings. Code 31 is reserved and is accepted solely for exact rollback.

functions.name: tg28_esp_check_chip_id
functions.doc: Read REG03 and compare with the TG28-ESP ID observed on Candis. No writes.

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_dcdc_outputs
functions.doc: Return the enabled DCDC1–4 bitmap in bits 0–3.

functions.name: tg28_esp_set_rail_enabled
functions.parameters: const tg28_esp_t *pmu, tg28_esp_rail_t rail, bool enabled
functions.doc: The caller owns supply sequencing and must identify rails feeding the MCU and PMU bus.

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_rail_voltage
functions.doc: Read the programmed setpoint, including the parent DCDC setpoint for a switch.

functions.name: tg28_esp_set_rail_voltage
functions.parameters: const tg28_esp_t *pmu, tg28_esp_rail_t rail, uint16_t mv
functions.doc: Exact mV setpoint. DC1SW and DC4SW follow their upstream supplies.

functions.name: tg28_esp_set_dcdc_pwm
functions.parameters: const tg28_esp_t *pmu, tg28_esp_rail_t rail, bool forced

functions.name: tg28_esp_set_adc_channels
functions.parameters: const tg28_esp_t *pmu, uint8_t mask, bool enabled

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_adc_raw
functions.doc: Read one enabled channel. GPADC has no documented sample registers in V1.0.

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_adc_uv
functions.doc: Return ADC input voltage. TS and DIE readings are sensor voltages. TS overflow returns ESP_ERR_INVALID_RESPONSE. Use read_adc_raw for diagnostics.

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_die_temperature
functions.doc: Estimate PMU die temperature in m°C from the vendor FAQ conversion.

functions.name: tg28_esp_clear_irq
functions.doc: Acknowledge only the specified W1C flags. Calling with pending flags may release IRQ.

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_charger
functions.doc: Read charger settings in mA and mV. Current fields are register setpoints.

functions.name: tg28_esp_set_charge_current
functions.doc: Write only the CC setpoint. Accept 0–200 mA in 25 mA steps, 300–1500 in 100 mA steps. The caller must enforce battery, supply and CV-dependent current limits.

functions.name: tg28_esp_set_charge_termination
functions.parameters: const tg28_esp_t *pmu, uint16_t ma, bool enabled

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_gauge_config
functions.doc: Read REG18[3] and REG A2. SRAM selection alone does not validate its contents.

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_sleep_controls
functions.doc: Read the two REG26 control bits. They do not report SoC sleep or rail voltage.

functions.name: tg28_esp_enter_sleep

functions.name: tg28_esp_request_wakeup
functions.doc: Request wake from an armed PMU while keeping SLEEP_EN asserted in the write.

functions.name: tg28_esp_configure_watchdog

functions.doc: Sequential read. Follow the access rules for the selected registers.

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_buffer
functions.doc: Four bytes of scratch storage. PMU power-on reset clears the buffer.

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_gpio1
functions.doc: An open-drain output. false selects high impedance. Check the package pinout.

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_soc_thresholds

functions.name: tg28_esp_set_soc_thresholds

functions.name: tg28_esp_request_power
functions.doc: Requires opt-in. The host may lose power before the I2C transaction completes.

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_dcdc_protection

functions.name: tg28_esp_set_die_protection

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_ts_override_uv

functions.name: tg28_esp_read_ts_temperature
functions.parameters: const tg28_esp_t *pmu, const tg28_esp_ts_point_t *curve, size_t count, int32_t *millicelsius
functions.doc: Read the enabled TS ADC and interpolate a board-specific calibration curve. Supply at least two points with strictly increasing voltage, calibrated for the fitted sensor, bias and resistor network. Out-of-curve samples return ESP_ERR_INVALID_RESPONSE.
